question: What is the air quality in Minden, Penang right now?
name: Claude
answer:
I can't get a live reading, so this is the most recent data my search turned up. It may not match conditions right now.

- **Latest snapshot (about a week old):** Hazemonitor's Penang page showed Minden as the highest station in the state. It listed Minden at 155 (US AQI, PM2.5) with an official API of 154, in the "Unhealthy" range. Its page was last indexed 7 days ago.
- **Recent trend:** Minden's readings have swung a lot in recent weeks.
  - On 16 September, Minden recorded the state's highest API at 167.
  - On 6 October at 8am, Minden was down to an API of 45, in the good range.
  - Haze returned on 8 October, when Minden hit 156.
- **AQICN:** It lists a Minden station, but the snippet I got was an old cached copy, so I wouldn't rely on it.

**Health advice:** At "Unhealthy" levels, people with respiratory problems, children, older adults and pregnant women should limit time outdoors. Authorities have advised the public to reduce outdoor activities and take precautions.

For the current number, check the Department of Environment's APIMS portal (apims.doe.gov.my), aqicn.org/city/malaysia/pulau-pinang/minden, or the MyIPU app. All three update hourly.
